why: No major reviewer or authority tests small solar generator kits under $500; Popular Mechanics is an off-target explainer and This Old House is an untested general roundup. The only page that names sub-$500 kits is an affiliate listicle of Amazon off-brands (positiveliberty), while the niche sites (powersized, WattList, Gadgeteer) cover stations without panels or kits well above $500. A focused page with current sub-$500 kit prices and a direct pick would stand out.
